description.value: Truck 59 Cider House is a craft cider tasting room perched along the West Kelowna wine trail with panoramic Okanagan Lake views, wide-open lawn space, and a laid-back family-friendly atmosphere. Part of the Jason Parkes Customs family of producers, it pours its own handcrafted ciders alongside beer from The Hatching Post, JPC wines, and cocktails in the newer adults-only Truck Yard section. A regular calendar of live music, food-truck pop-ups, and seasonal events makes it a lively stop on a West Kelowna ride.

address.value: 2345 Boucherie Road, West Kelowna, BC V1Z 2E6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and active, confirming the business is open with summer hours, events, and an online shop. A significant address discrepancy exists: OSM lists 3887 Brown Road while the website's contact page clearly states 2345 Boucherie Road, West Kelowna, BC V1Z 2E6 — the website value is used as it is likely more current. No bike parking, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the site, and food references are limited to catering for private events and food-truck pop-ups with no dietary specifics; takeout of bottled/canned cider is confirmed via the tasting room and online shop.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM lists 3887 Brown Road but the website contact page lists 2345 Boucherie Road, West Kelowna, BC V1Z 2E6. The website value has been used; the OSM record should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible cider tasting room on the West Kelowna wine trail — a natural stop for touring cyclists in the Okanagan.
